Hi Eva — appreciate the note and the agenda. We definitely want the APAC folks included; the US/EU DST offset this week means a single slot that’s comfortable for all three regions is tight. Quick thoughts below and two concrete options: 

Key constraint: US springs forward earlier (second Sunday in March) than EU (last Sunday in March) this year, so between those dates there is a week where US clocks are one hour ahead of usual relative to EU. That typically pushes early-ET slots later for EU participants.

Options we can offer that keep the demo single-session:
- Option A (APAC-friendly evening): 15:00 CET / 10:00 ET / 00:00 AEST (next day) — keeps EU morning, OK for US mid-morning, late for APAC (only for Sydney/NZ attendees)
- Option B (US-friendly morning): 08:30 CET / 03:30 ET / 19:30 AEST — early for US but avoids midnight for APAC sub-team in India/SEA; not great for Sydney

Alternative: run a 45-minute global session + a 20-minute follow-up for APAC-specific ops, so nobody sits through a late-night deep dive.

If you can confirm stakeholders and whether APAC needs live attendance or can take the recording, I’ll lock in the best time. We can also offer two short hands-on slots (US/EU) back-to-back and stitch them with a short intro.

I’ve attached the mutual action plan with roles so we can map attendees.

Thanks — Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding Eva’s note. Short coordination: she asked for a single global slot but flagged the US/EU DST mismatch. My read is: we should propose a primary single-session option that minimizes total inconvenience, plus an alternate plan of a split session if APAC requires live participation.

Operational asks for scheduling and SRE coverage:
- Hannah: can you estimate if we can run a two-window approach without additional ramp (45m global + 20m APAC)? I want to avoid engineering late-night callouts.
- Marissa: can you pull a 1-hour calendar hold for Option A (15:00 CET / 10:00 ET) on 2026-03-12 and include a brief agenda and recording link placeholder?
- Aditya: if we need to run a split session, can you prepare a short APAC-focused demo fragment we can slot at 19:30 AEST (local) so it’s not a midnight deep dive?

Notes for invites: include explicit local-time conversions in the invite body and put a calendar note: "US/EU DST mismatch week — confirm local time before accepting." That reduces confusion and declines.

Quick confirmations please — I’ll send options to Eva once I have yes/no.

— Rohan
